reviews: Spent four hours building an arena with campfires and heart lanterns only to get obliterated by Empress of Light during daytime.
The progression from wooden armor and a copper shortsword to fighting Moon Lord with Zenith is unmatched in 2D sandbox games.
Pre-Hardmode exploration is super relaxing, especially discovering floating islands, underground marble caves, and the Aether shimmer pool.
Building NPC pylons across every biome makes fast travel a breeze once you figure out who likes living next to whom.
Trying to stop the Corruption from spreading across half my world right after entering Hardmode gave me genuine anxiety.
Ranger class with the Daedalus Stormbow and Holy Arrows completely melts mechanical bosses if you have enough vertical space.
Crafting the Terraspark Boots takes forever because of the Lava Charm RNG, though the mobility upgrade is totally worth it.
My cat walked across my keyboard and somehow ordered pizza while this was minimizing in the background.
Specs: i7-13700K, RTX 4070, 32GB RAM, 1TB NVMe SSD. Runs great, also check out my Steam profile for CS2 skins.
I only bought this because my friend told me it was 2D Minecraft and now I have 900 hours, send help.
